 Meta Reports Q3 Revenue Up 26% to $64.6B, EPS Misses Estimates
 Bae Seong-jae 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.10.22 06:37 
 View 
 View Count 
 Enlarge image 
 ▲ Meta 
 Meta announced on the 21st local time that its third-quarter revenue increased by 26% compared to the same period last year, reaching $64.6 billion. 
 This figure surpasses the market expectation of $63.4 billion compiled by market research firm London Stock Exchange Group. 
 However, earnings per share (EPS) stood at $3.83, falling short of the market expectation of $5.75.
